invariants: The public ontology contains no episode-specific support, physical truth, intervention identity, or evaluator gold fields.
Diagnostic specificity is a per-family DAG; incomparable mechanism families are not forced into one global scalar order.
Claim support is derived from all required evidence statuses and cannot be asserted independently.
FALSE_PREMISE results cannot approve a failure-mechanism claim.
AMBIGUOUS results require at least two incomparable maximal alternatives.
The command-motion discrepancy contract requires valid synchronized command and odometry evidence and does not entail motor failure, collision, slip, obstruction, or hidden intervention identity.

confirmation.reason: P2 through P10 have development implementations, but the fresh pilot, human annotation dry run, and P11 semantic freeze remain incomplete.
